visualCharacteristics: A centred-slide entertainment carousel with large background images, peeking neighbour slides, an overlaid title and sub line, a light CTA button and prev/next chevrons.
contentPattern: One row per slide: cell 1 holds the picture(s) (first portrait for mobile, second landscape for desktop); cell 2 holds the title (h3 or p), a sub line paragraph, an optional plain link paragraph (whole-slide link) and a CTA paragraph (em strong link = light button).
usage: Use to showcase featured entertainment or promotional content as large image slides rotating around a centred slide.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any full-image promotional slider with a title and one CTA per slide; use article-carousel for small article cards instead.
